keys.name: READY
keys.pose_rig: upright staggered base with open recovery space behind root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stable before incoming consequence; wall is behind but not yet binding

keys.name: RECOIL_INBOUND
keys.pose_rig: torso and pelvis translating toward wall while rear support begins to load
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root travels right toward wall; upper line lags and begins counter-arc
keys.causal_role: balance loss and recoil travel before environmental contact

keys.name: WALL_CONTACT
keys.pose_rig: root reaches wall constraint while torso is still driven into the contact side
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root-x retreat is denied at wall; contact direction remains rightward into constraint
keys.causal_role: environmental contact / forbidden recoil degree of freedom

keys.name: COMPRESSION_BANK
keys.pose_rig: root remains clamped while knees/spine fold and silhouette widens away from contact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: no further root-x travel; residual recoil is stored as lower root height, spine shear, and widened base
keys.causal_role: held hit reaction / recoil debt converted into compression

keys.name: LATERAL_PROBE
keys.pose_rig: one support preserves the compressed root while the free foot probes down-left for an escape line
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root begins vertical/lateral shear without violating the wall clamp; no new support is claimed yet

keys.name: LATERAL_PLANT
keys.pose_rig: probe foot earns support at offset address and root begins to peel away from wall
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new plant absorbs lateral shear; wall contact releases only after support exists
keys.causal_role: first trustworthy recovery support / contact release

keys.name: WALL_RELEASE_RESTACK
keys.pose_rig: torso rises over the new support base while the wall is no longer a constraint
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root moves left and upward from wall, preserving displacement rather than snapping to the original address

keys.name: READY_OFFSET
keys.pose_rig: ready silhouette rebuilt at a new address clear of the wall
keys.motion_arc_root_note: state re-entry completes at displaced root address; recoil consequence remains spatially legible
keys.causal_role: state re-entry after hit reaction and constraint escape
